notes.title: Demo Update 20250821
notes.content:
[olist]
Raise the base critical hit damage to 200%

Fix bug in hole-in-one challenge

Slightly decrease friction force

Add text notifications during pillar upgrades

CP reward bonuses will increase if CP hasn't been chosen as battle reward for more than 3 consecutive times
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo Update 20250812
notes.content:
After the update, the tutorial will be completed again.
[olist]
Updated the save data format (therefore players need to go through the tutorial again).

Updated the style of all pool tables to make positions clear to see.

Updated the UI for selecting characters, tables, and levels.

The first level now lets you directly choose an item, and you can exchange part of your HP into money.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo Update 20250723
notes.content:
[olist]
Fixed an issue where poweroff cast could be mistakenly triggered at the beginning of a turn.

Fixed an issue where players might unexpectedly leave during challenges (fixed again!).
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo Update 20250722
notes.content:
[olist]
Increased the upgrade cap and values for Posts, slightly reduced initial attributes.

Fixed a bug where accidentally touching the door during challenges in the rest room would cause you to leave.
[/olist]

notes.title: Demo Content Update 20250721
notes.content:
1. New Mechanism: Posts on the pool table can be upgraded through collisions.

2. Adjusted initial ball speed and bullet time effect after clearing enemies.

3. Adjusted character layout in the restroom and diversified pool tables in the hole-in-one challenge.
